uses.quote: We endorse the use of AI as an assistive technology, ensuring barriers to the use of AI tools are removed for all staff and students.

decided_by.quote: The University has developed a Common Approach to ensure every undergraduate programme integrates GenAI literacy through structured teaching activities and formal assessment, while providing clarity to staff and students about acceptable AI use across all assessments.
These expectations are clearly communicated to students in programme and module handbooks and align with the academic misconduct policy principles and underpinning values.

Clarity will be provided within assessment criteria regarding how AI can contribute to or detract from the achievement of learning objectives, including recognition for appropriate and responsible use.
